# webtables/while

> Loop: `while cond ... [next ...] end`, as a `loop` inside a `block`.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/while.pkg) · translates [std/while](../std/while.md)

`break` leaves the outer block (`{L.end}`); `continue` leaves the inner
block around the body (`{L.next}`), so the `next` block (`{step}`) runs
before the loop branches back to `{L.top}`.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
(block ${L.end}
(loop ${L.top}
(block ${L.next}
(br_if ${L.end} (i64.eqz
{cond}
))
{body}
)
{step}
(br ${L.top})))
```
